target.role: resolve intentional Spotify/ledger divergence created by three listener-added tracks
target.position: evaluate Linear System — Transparency → Ignez — When We Froze → Len Faki — Stardancer as an intact ordered block, currently after Inspired Groove — Truth in Noise
target.purpose: decide KEEP/MOVE/REMOVE for the listener-added trio while preserving the user's preferred internal order; internal handoffs have positive listener evidence, but the Truth in Noise → Transparency entry remains unverified by listener report

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.

warnings.warning: Exact title/artist matched with release metadata variance: album requested "One Hundred Fifty" but Spotify returned "Stardancer"

requestedIdentity.bpmSource: SongData and independent DJ-pool metadata report 143 BPM; Beatport reports a conflicting 107 BPM, preserved as an anomaly
requestedIdentity.discoverySource: Listener manually added the exact Spotify track from Spotify recommendations. Subhills official SR043 release confirms identity and 6:21 duration.

proposedPlacements.position: after Inspired Groove — Truth in Noise as Track 10, beginning the listener-ordered three-track block

requestedIdentity.fitHypothesis: Transparency plausibly opens a new high-130s/low-140s hypnotic run after Truth in Noise, but the exact entry handoff has not been reported by the listener; its main current value is as the required first member of a listener-confirmed internal trio.

measured: exact Spotify ID from live playlist read-back
tempo evidence conflict: 143 BPM from SongData/DJ-pool metadata vs 107 BPM on Beatport
evidence.attributedDescription: Subhills official release confirms SR043 identity but provides no exact-track sonic description; Beatport classifies the track as Techno (Raw / Deep / Hypnotic).
evidence.listenerEvidence: User reports the manually added three-track sequence Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer comes in perfect harmony in that order using Spotify Mix; this does not explicitly establish the preceding Truth in Noise → Transparency handoff.
evidence.craftConvention: A listener-confirmed micro-sequence may be kept intact even if the first entry into that block remains provisional.
